expectedOutcome: This will enable the development of a problem-solving strategy on a problem-by-problem basis and the development of interview redisposals covering arrays, trees, maps, dynamic programming and synthesis.
goal: The main algorithm interview type is covered by NetCode 150.
notRecommendedFor: One to two weeks of interview preparation.
All I want is a single weak subject break.

phases.focus: Completion of NetCode 150 medium array and hash topics and establishment of frequency, weight and grouping models.
phases.title: Group and Hash

phases.focus: Completion of dual-guided and window-glie topics, training in window maintenance, border control and contraction conditions.
phases.title: two pointers and Slide Window

phases.focus: Completion of inn and semi-titles, training in monotony structure, brackets and border searches.
phases.title: Bark and Half Search

phases.focus: Completion of chain and inter-sector topics, training in the rewriting, consolidation, insertion and movement of guidelines.
phases.title: Chain and interval

phases.focus: Completion of tree titles, training in DFS/BFS, regression values, serialization and binary search for tree properties.
phases.title: Trees and Recursives

phases.focus: Finish Trie and stacking, training prefix modeling, Top K and priority scheduling.
phases.title: Trie and stack

phases.focus: Retrospect, training in tree selection, cutting and recovery.
phases.title: Backtracking

phases.focus: Completion of graph search topics, training in connectivity blocks, poking relationships, BFS/DFS and grid modelling.
phases.title: Figure Search

phases.focus: :: Completion of the road map and the topic of greed, training in the shortest possible routes, mapping and local proof of excellence.
phases.title: Progress map and greed

phases.focus: Completion of one-dimensional dynamic programming topics, training status definition, transfer sequence and rolling optimization.
phases.title: One-dimensional dynamic programming

phases.focus: Completion of 2D dynamic programming topics, training grid, inter-dimensional and multi-dimensional design.
phases.title: Two-dimensional dynamic programming

phases.focus: Completion of field computing, mathematical geometry and integrated winding-up topics, and preparation of the complete rediscovery of the route.
phases.title: Bitwork, Math and Combined End

prerequisites: Basic grammar of a dominant language
Understanding common data structure and time complexity
A steady input of over 8 hours per week
recommendedFor: Wishing to brush the system by the theme mode
Scratched a few questions but missing a full route.
summary: 12 weeks of coverage of NetCode 150 mainstream algorithm interview mode, suitable for medium-term system readiness.
targetAudience: There are 2 to 3 month preparation cycles for learners who want system coverage on trial algorithms.
title: NetCode 150 System Interview Scheme
